The background shows a wooden table surface cluttered with red envelopes and loose currency under bright, neutral indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a person fanning a much larger, thicker stack of blue banknotes. The hands are shown from a slightly elevated angle, rotating the massive fan to display the repetitive pattern and holographic security strips of the notes against a blurred indoor background. (3) A tight close-up provides a detailed view of the hand positioning: the left thumb anchors the bottom corner of the stack while the right hand's fingers slide the bills in a smooth, circular arc. No faces are shown, focusing entirely on the manual dexterity and object state. (4) Two people are now visible from a high-angle perspective standing on a speckled tile floor. One individual in a tan sweater demonstrates the fanning technique to another person in a black coat, physically guiding their hand placement and the pivoting motion. (5) The video concludes as the camera follows the two individuals walking across the tiled floor. Both persons hold large, completed fans of currency—one red and one blue—as they move out of the frame, showcasing the final result of the demonstration.
